cases.situation: My coworker Anika told me in our 1:1 that I talk over people in team meetings, especially the junior folks. It stung but I think she's right. Want to message her after.
cases.reply: Thanks for telling me that earlier, Anika, I know it wasn't an easy thing to raise. You're right that I jump in before people finish, and I hadn't noticed it was mostly with Sam and Lucy. I'm going to hold my comments until they've wrapped up. Would you give me a nudge after Thursday's standup if I slip?
cases.note: Reflect the point, own it without explaining it away, and ask for help catching it next time.

cases.situation: 我在家长群里组织了班级春游，有个家长在群里说我选的地方太远、费用太高也没跟大家商量。其实我提前发过投票，但费用确实比去年高。
cases.reply: 谢谢王妈妈提出来。费用比去年高这点确实是，主要是今年多了一段大巴。地点之前在群里发过投票，可能消息多被刷过去了，下次我会单独@大家确认。费用和路程的具体情况我私下跟您细说，免得刷屏。
cases.note: 公开场合：认下对的部分，平静说明一次事实，然后转私聊，不在群里辩。

cases.situation: My manager said in my review that I'm 'not a team player' because I declined to join the weekend offsite planning committee. I don't think that's fair, I led two cross-team projects this year.
cases.reply: Thanks for being direct about it. I see this differently: this year I led the checkout redesign and the vendor consolidation, both with three other teams, and I'd count that as team work. I'm not trying to shut the feedback down, I just don't want to agree with something I don't think is accurate. Could you tell me what you'd want to see from me that I'm missing?
cases.note: You don't have to agree or fight. State your view once and ask a question that moves it forward.

cases.situation: 最好的朋友阿琳微信跟我说，我这两个月放了她三次鸽子，每次都是临时说加班，她觉得自己在我生活里排在最后。鸽子确实是我放的，加班也是真的。
cases.reply: 你说得对，这两个月我放了你三次鸽子，每次还都是最后一刻才说，换我也会觉得自己被排在后面。谢谢你直接告诉我，而不是就这么冷下来。这周六中午我请你吃那家云南菜好不好？那天我已经空出来了，一定到。
cases.note: 对方说的是事实就直接认，不提加班；这时候的解释听起来就是借口。用一次具体的赴约来证明。
